$comment: Runtime limits for an evor mission. Declared, never inherited.
was turned OFF by default in 2.1.217 (depth 1), and restored at depth 3 in
2.1.219. The ceiling is 5. evor's tree is main(0) -> evor-tick(1) ->
leads(2) -> juniors(3), so depth 3 is the minimum that lets forge-junior and
sage-junior spawn at all. 4 leaves one level of headroom without pretending
to a depth the design does not use. A default that has already moved twice is
not something a 100-200 tick mission should depend on silently.
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENTS_PER_SESSION: the 200 default binds around tick
20-22 at the observed ~7-9 spawns/tick, far inside the target run length.
Raised to 2000 to cover 200 ticks. Note this is a runaway-loop backstop, so
raising it removes a safety net: maxTurns in the agent frontmatter and the
session rotation planned for Phase 4.1 are what bound spawn growth instead.
CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS: sized against the widest fan-out in
the system, Forge's four reviewers plus its junior. 8 leaves room for two
such fan-outs without queueing; the default is 20.
